acceptanceCriteria: From a task plan, emit a runnable test in the target suite's framework and conventions, reusing existing page objects, setup records and fixtures, placed beside the closest existing spec.
Every generated line traces to a learned evidence record; anything without evidence is a marked TODO and the result is reported incomplete, never claimed done.
Extends AMSP `flows appmap plan --request --draft` (test.fixme skeleton) and the corvint.map_plan MCP tool instead of a parallel surface.
Given the CCE-V0 compile kill (V1-1677 0/10 useful; V1-1733 pivot), emits only mined, anchored statements and assertions copied from real tests; anything else is an abstention, not synthesized code.
body: Owner goal (2026-10-19): from an app's existing tests, learn every page object, link/navigation, data setup and the step sequences that do anything in the site; then 'show me how to do X' builds an e2e test that demonstrates X, proven by a live run, or abstains naming what is missing. Inventory at origin/main 6ceee260b: appmap screens/page-object bindings (AMAP-V0), navigation ledger (ANL-V0), flows (AFU-V1), legacy discovery/crosswalk (DCP-V1-060..069), test-knowledge (DCP-V1-086..092, PR #1165), AMSP draft planner, CCE compile/prove (partly unbuilt), NEA/RVN/PWP/TSA validation pieces exist but are not chained. AMSP --draft and AMAP scaffold emit guarded skeletons; CCE compile is partly unbuilt (CCE-V0-010..025).
title: Site knowledge 7: generate a runnable e2e test (setup + page-object calls + assertions) from a task plan
